source_refs.locator: Press-release summary, CCDR headline paragraph on potential economic losses and health costs.

evidence.scenario: Without reforms, diversification and climate action, as stated in the summary; underlying model assumptions are not stated there.

recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

evidence.compact_statement: For December 2023 floods across nine departments, initial government estimates as of January 2024 counted 336,560 people affected and 23 deaths; homes, schools, health centers, water and sanitation were disrupted, and farming and fishing halted.
